stimulus.comparison: decoded film on physical emitting screen versus black physical screen

fields.response_semantics: ever exceeded absolute paired-condition difference 1e-6 over 600 ticks; stream timings are not a simultaneous-response claim

source.text: The paired film and blank executions differed in resident 0 retina and neural rates, and in actions and physical motion across the three-resident batch.

records.text: The paired film and blank executions differed in resident 0 retina and neural rates, and in actions and physical motion across the three-resident batch.

fields.diagnosis: The failed collector reused an options object mutated by the Emscripten factory; this was a caller/options-lifetime bug, not a MuJoCo singleton restriction.
fields.error: MuJoCo Emscripten singleton refused a second factory initialization: noExitRuntime was not exported
fields.resolution: LiveEngine now retains immutable Wasm bytes and passes a fresh {wasmBinary} object to every factory initialization; later independent initialization passed.
